mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate level signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days when the rate is below 2.0%.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase above 4.0% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production and housing starts indicate manufacturing and construction sector contraction, reducing corporate investment and economic growth prospects, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline from prior month values.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a retail sales decline signals weakening consumer demand that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS declines > 0.5% and regime is late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases by more than 100,000 jobs from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly core CPI increase above 2.5% signals accelerating inflation that prompts monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL increases > 2.5% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales and housing starts indicate broad-based demand weakness that reduces corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline from prior month values.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing slowdown regimes, an industrial production decline below 105.0 signals sector contraction that reduces corporate profits, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0 and regime is manufacturing slowdown.
